cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant city known for its iconic Sydney Opera House, beautiful harbor, and stunning beaches.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural hub famous for its art, food, coffee culture, laneways, and lively entertainment scene.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling metropolis blending modern technology, traditional temples, shopping districts, and world-class cuisine.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: A historic city filled with peaceful temples, traditional wooden houses, gardens, and cultural landmarks.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: A lively city famous for Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana Beach, Sugarloaf Mountain, and carnival celebrations.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Brazil's largest city, known for its cultural diversity, restaurants, museums, and energetic urban lifestyle.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A magnificent temple complex and UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its ancient Khmer architecture.

temples.name: Kinkaku-ji, Japan
temples.description: Also known as the Golden Pavilion, this Zen Buddhist temple is famous for its stunning gold-covered exterior.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A tropical paradise known for turquoise waters, luxury resorts, coral reefs, and breathtaking lagoon views.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A world-famous beach in Rio de Janeiro, celebrated for its lively atmosphere, golden sand, and scenic coastline.
